title: thesium ramosum var. divaricatum
intro: Thesium ramosum var. divaricatum, commonly known as the starflower, is a flowering plant species within the Thesium genus, known for its unique star-shaped flowers. The starflower is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of the starflower are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antiparasitic activities. The bioactive constituents of the starflower, particularly its sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, may also have a positive effect on the immune system and may help to reduce oxidative stress.
